The scores from the three paths suggest a consistent but variable strength of this relationship, with the highest confidence in the connection through Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Sanguisorbigenin and TAR DNA-binding protein 43, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated. The observed correlations are supported by multiple independent pathways, reinforcing the likelihood of a functional relationship, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the biological relevance.
